name: Netflix / Apple Music Theme
overview: Netflix-like video browsing and Apple Music-like music browsing for Jellyfin 12.0.
description: Restyles the Jellyfin 12.0 web client: Netflix-like browsing for movies and shows, Apple Music-like browsing for music. The stylesheet is applied at request time, so nothing is written to the web root and a web client update cannot undo it.
